name: Athagan of Wildale
source:
Count of Wildale. Lord Protector of Aetas. Former member of the Iron Quintet. Defeated the demon horde's first invasion.

[spoiler]Adoptive father of [url=https://vndb.org/c139241]Henri[/url].[/spoiler] Husband of [url=https://vndb.org/c139244]Liliana[/url]. Father of [url=https://vndb.org/c139248]Avila[/url]. [spoiler]Adoptive grandfather of [url=https://vndb.org/c139290]Maria[/url].[/spoiler]
